TA0012.title: Malware Developers
TA0012.description:
Malware developers are the technical role in the illicit chain responsible for writing, customizing, and maintaining trojans, ransomware, cryptominers, RATs, and keyloggers. Upstream they take orders from illicit teams (e.g., a trojan targeting a specific payment app, or a cheat for a specific game); downstream they distribute via dark-web forums, Telegram groups, or street-promotion channels.

Their outputs typically feature AV evasion, packing, anti-debugging, dynamic loading, and C2 communication to bypass antivirus and sandbox detection, and are disguised as system updates, cracked software, or cheat plugins to trick users into installation. They directly cause data theft (R0051), ransomware (R0012-002), and remote-control hijacking (R0080), and routinely collaborate with black-market organizations (TA0017) and ransomware groups (TA0018), forming a specialized outsourcing market for attack-tool development.
